subject: Human-requested direct voice flow replaces confirmation gates
body: Human explicitly asks for one button, ElevenLabs speaking both questions, automatic listening and direct results with no checkboxes or transcript confirmation. D will implement this flow, retain optional typed entry and cancellation, and record C002 changes: inputMode=voice for unconfirmed recognized speech, requiresConfirmation=false, activity goal up to5000 chars to preserve full transcript. Browser microphone permission remains browser-controlled. Shared source checks, bounded audio, supervised budgets and emergency policy remain. No peer ACKs will be fabricated; this follows direct human product authorization. Tests remain skipped at human request.
